scope: Source synchronization, not reproduction of historical experiments or a full workspace backup.

static_checks.method: Syntax compilation and parsing without executing source; manifests checked against Git index and original files.

groups.name: Codex batch, evidence and ordering gates
QA production, presentation, feedback, transport and budget
Base QA pipeline, schemas, option freeze and mock transport

selected_offline_tests.isolation: Source-only checkout with real network, model imports and private/original workspace access blocked. Three tests needing a fresh process initially hit the process guard and passed on rerun with only their reviewed synthetic child programs allowed; those children retained the isolation guards.
selected_offline_tests.limitations: Selected synthetic and mock tests only. Some historical tests need excluded fixtures, immutable inputs and budget ledgers. No model, Solver, training or benchmark inference was run.

publication_scope.mixed_source_and_actual_data: Excluded as complete files and listed in the source completeness manifests; original files remain local.
publication_scope.third_party_reference_copies: Known copies without verified redistribution permissions are excluded and recorded with origin.
publication_scope.credentials: Final staged index checked for common credential patterns before publication; pattern matching cannot establish that every possible secret representation is absent.
publication_scope.historical_whitespace: Some verbatim historical files contain trailing whitespace; preserved to retain original bytes.
